publication.release_notes: Initial sports research integration: schedules, player lookup and public profiles, team context, and existing public NFL projected scores. No account linking, checkout or wagers.

interface.longDescription: Ask LineCrush about sports schedules, player research, team injury context, recent coach context and matchup research. Find players by name, retrieve their public research summaries, and inspect the public weekly NFL projected score when available. Responses include LineCrush source links and disclose missing data and research dates. Injury coverage varies by sport and source, and unavailable timestamps are disclosed. The integration does not place wagers, provide stake sizing, connect sportsbook accounts, or access private LineCrush accounts.
